methodology.title: How scores are calculated
methodology.description: How Ratable calculates scores: verified reviews only, a minimum per criterion, and no influence from payment.
methodology.heading: How scores are calculated
methodology.intro: A Ratable score is simple and public. These are the rules.

items.title: Verified reviews only
items.text: Only reviews from people who proved their visit or purchase count. An unverified review is shown with a clear label and never changes the score.

items.title: Every review weighs the same
items.text: The overall score is the average of the verified reviews' scores. One review's score is the average of the criteria its author answered.

items.title: A minimum per criterion
items.text: A criterion's score appears only after at least 5 verified answers, so it never rests on one opinion.

items.title: One review per account
items.text: Each account has one review per place. Every edit is saved in a dated history, and a deleted review is hidden while its history is kept.

items.title: No paid influence
items.text: Nothing a business pays for changes a score, a ranking or removes a review.

items.title: Protected identity
items.text: If a reviewer chooses to be anonymous, their name never appears anywhere.
